name: web-liquid-glass-quote-card-cube-accent
title: Liquid-glass quote card with crystalline cube props
whatItIs: A third variant of the glass quote card series, using faceted crystal cube shapes instead of spheres at the panel corners.
whatItMeans: Swapping only the prop geometry across a template family shows how a design system can stay recognizable while still varying enough to avoid repetition fatigue.
techniques: build a template family by holding background and typography constant while rotating one decorative element
use faceted, multi-plane props to catch varied light angles and add realism

vocabulary.definition: having multiple flat plane surfaces, as cut on a gemstone, used to catch and vary light reflection
